_about: Level 1's own targets: full-size subjects of the 0.4 rounds, painted freehand with the toolkit (bench/scripts/v3.mjs). They are NOT part of the public suite (bench/v2/crops.json), its leaderboard or its routine runs. Files are relative to bench/v3/.

crops.name: Mittens close-up
crops.style: watercolor sketch over faint pencil, no ink: an orange cat's face, close up
crops.source: watercolour sketch made by an image generator from the owner's photograph
crops.licence: noncommercial project use; local branch only, not distributed

unit.from: prepared mittens-closeup at f58e226f (v0.4.0-rc.2): one full look of the automatic plan

crops.name: Mittens close-up, full size
crops.style: watercolor sketch over faint pencil, no ink: an orange cat's face, close up
crops.source: watercolour sketch made by an image generator from the owner's photograph
crops.licence: noncommercial project use; local branch only, not distributed

crops.name: White Ships, full size
crops.style: pure watercolor, no ink: white sailing ships moored side by side, masts, rigging and reflections (after Sargent)
crops.source: John Singer Sargent, White Ships, 1908, Brooklyn Museum; public domain

unit.from: prepared white-ships at 3b5366fe (v0.4.0-rc.3; none was prepared at rc.2): one full look of the automatic plan

crops.name: Yale Rosewalk, full size
crops.style: loose ink-and-watercolor field sketch, ink led: a college walk with a gate and dappled shade
crops.licence: noncommercial project use; local branch only, not distributed

crops.name: A Fisherman's Daughter, full size
crops.style: watercolor and gouache over faint pencil, no ink: three girls in straw hats seated on a stone wall looking at a lobster, an upturned boat and grass behind, a sandy shore in front (Winslow Homer)
crops.source: Winslow Homer, A Fisherman's Daughter, 1873, Cleveland Museum of Art 1943.660; CC0

unit.from: prepared homer-daughter at f58e226f (v0.4.0-rc.2): one full look of the automatic plan; its full-size painting counted 11321 water steps

crops.name: Rinaldo in the Enchanted Forest, full size
crops.style: brown wash over chalk on buff paper, no ink: a helmeted knight with sword and shield fighting monsters in a forest, a winged figure and clouds above (Fragonard)
crops.source: Jean-Honore Fragonard, Rinaldo in the Enchanted Forest, brown wash over chalk; public domain

unit.from: prepared fragonard at 3b5366fe (v0.4.0-rc.3; none was prepared at rc.2): one full look of the automatic plan

crops.name: Lindisfarne Castle (trial, not a benchmark subject)
crops.style: watercolour and bodycolour, no ink: a castle on a high rock under a cloudy sky, smoke along its foot, water and a shore with small figures (after Thomas Girtin)
crops.source: Thomas Girtin, Lindisfarne Castle, Holy Island, 1796-97, The Metropolitan Museum of Art 06.1051.1; CC0
